column1: # Time-limited exceptions for fixable HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities (read by trivy-check.sh and vuln-grace.sh).
# Normally not needed: every finding is allowed automatically for a grace period from the day it was first seen
# (CRITICAL 7 days, HIGH 14 days – see the issue labelled "vuln-grace"). Only if a fix takes longer, add a line
# here by pull request. Columns separated by ONE TAB:
#   ID   package (* = any)   until (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 30 days ahead – later dates are not accepted)   reason
# Remove the line once the fix is out. Secrets in the image are never excepted.
